description: 2020 Land Rover Range Rover Sport HSE P360  SVO Premium Palette Blue  3.0L Turbocharged Inline-6 Mild Hybrid  Four-Wheel Drive  73,758 MilesDistinctive SVO Premium Palette styling, sophisticated British luxury, electrified turbocharged performance, and legendary Range Rover capability come together in this stunning 2020 Range Rover Sport HSE P360. Finished in an exclusive SVO Premium Palette Blue, this Range Rover immediately separates itself from ordinary examples. Special Vehicle Operations bespoke program was created to offer personalized paint colors and finishes for customers seeking something genuinely distinctive. Showing 73,758 miles, this HSE combines commanding presence with premium craftsmanship, advanced technology, and serious four-wheel-drive capability.Under the hood is Land Rovers advanced 3.0-liter Ingenium turbocharged inline-six P360 Mild Hybrid Electric Vehicle powertrain, producing 355 horsepower and 365 lb-ft of torque. The sophisticated 48-volt system works with an electric supercharger and twin-scroll turbocharger to deliver quick response and reduce turbo lag. Energy recovered during deceleration is stored and used to support the powertrain, while Intelligent Stop/Start technology helps improve everyday efficiency. An 8-speed automatic transmission and permanent four-wheel drive provide smooth acceleration and confident traction in changing conditions.The engineering underneath is equally impressive. Electronic air suspension delivers the smooth, composed ride Range Rover is famous for while allowing the vehicles height to adapt to different situations. Land Rovers four-wheel-drive engineering gives this Sport genuine capability beyond the pavement, while a properly equipped Range Rover Sport can tow up to approximately 7,716 poundsmaking it just as capable of pulling recreational equipment as it is arriving at an upscale destination.The premium equipment is where the HSE really shines. Highlights include 20-inch alloy wheels, Premium LED headlights, front fog lamps, a panoramic glass roof, heated power-folding exterior mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, and a power liftgate. The rare SVO Premium Palette Blue finish makes the Range Rover Sports muscular shoulders, floating-roof design, signature grille, and athletic proportions look especially dramatic.Inside, the HSE surrounds occupants with genuine luxury, including perforated Windsor leather upholstery and 16-way heated power front seats with memory. Premium materials, ambient interior lighting, a power-adjustable steering column, and a commanding driving position create a cabin designed for both comfort and control. The 996 represents a pivotal chapter in Porsche history, marking the transition of the legendary 911 to a water-cooled flat-six while retaining the rear-engine layout, unmistakable silhouette, and focused driving character that made the 911 an icon. This Carrera Cabriolet is powered by a 3.6-liter naturally aspirated flat-six producing 320 horsepower, sending power to the rear wheels through Porsches automatic transmission. The naturally aspirated engine delivers the responsive throttle, distinctive flat-six soundtrack, and linear power delivery that make this generation of 911 so enjoyable to drive, while the convertible body style adds an entirely different dimension to the experience. What immediately sets this particular example apart is its Aero Kit, giving the car a more aggressive and purposeful appearance than a standard Carrera Cabriolet. The factory aerodynamic package enhances the 996s already iconic shape with sportier exterior detailing, creating a lower, more performance-oriented visual presence while remaining true to Porsches original design language. Rather than an aftermarket modification, the Aero Kit was a factory-developed option designed specifically for the 996, making it particularly appealing to enthusiasts who appreciate originality and period-correct Porsche equipment. The combination of the Aero Kit with the Black exterior gives this Cabriolet a particularly sinister and sophisticated appearance, while the Tan leather interior provides a beautiful contrast and brings warmth to the cabin. Inside, the classic 996 cockpit remains focused on the driver, with Porsches unmistakable five-gauge instrument cluster, supportive power seats, leather appointments, and a straightforward layout that emphasizes driving rather than unnecessary complexity. The Cabriolet configuration also makes this 911 an exceptionally versatile sports car, allowing the driver to enjoy the character of the flat-six with the top down while retaining the usability and practicality that have always distinguished the 911 from more specialized sports cars. With only 29K miles, this example has covered considerably fewer miles than many of its contemporaries, making its low-mileage presentation particularly noteworthy. The rear-wheel-drive configuration further emphasizes the traditional 911 driving experience, allowing the chassis and rear-mounted flat-six to deliver the distinctive balance and traction characteristics that have defined the model for generations. The alloy wheels, spoiler, fog lights, leather seating, power seats, cruise control, and other factory equipment further enhance its combination of performance and everyday usability. As the 996 continues to gain appreciation among Porsche enthusiasts, well-preserved examples with distinctive factory equipment are becoming increasingly attractive. This Cabriolet offers the opportunity to enjoy the engaging character of an early water-cooled 911 while retaining the analog feel, unmistakable styling, and open-air experience that make these cars so special. With 29K miles, a Black exterior, Tan interior, rear-wheel drive, and the factory Aero Kit, this 2003 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet represents a particularly compelling example of the 996 generation and a wonderful way to experience one of Porsches most significant modern 911s. description: Gateway Classic Cars of San Antonio/Austin is excited to present this 2001 Dodge Viper, finished in a bold Yellow and Black exterior over a Black leather interior. With its unmistakable low-slung profile, aggressive proportions, and unmistakable Viper styling, this American sports car makes its performance intentions clear before the engine is even started.  At the heart of the Viper is its 8.0-liter OHV V10, paired with a BorgWarner/Tremec T-56 6-speed manual transmission. The V10 has been complemented by long-tube headers along with a dual K&N air filter setup housed in a carbon fiber air box, adding performance-oriented upgrades to an already formidable powertrain.  The Yellow and Black exterior is complemented by Black aluminum wheels, giving the Viper an even more aggressive appearance against its wide stance and distinctive bodywork. Power steering and power brakes provide additional control while maintaining the driver-focused character of the car.  Inside, the Black leather cabin keeps the focus on driving while providing several comfort and convenience features. Air conditioning, power windows, power locks, and an AM/FM radio provide modern amenities alongside the Viper's performance-oriented layout.  As a fun piece of Viper history, the original concept debuted in 1989 with inspiration from the legendary Shelby Cobra. The Viper was also famously developed with an emphasis on keeping the driving experience raw and straightforward, helping it earn a reputation as one of America's most unapologetic sports cars.  With its massive 8.0-liter V10, T-56 6-speed manual transmission, long-tube headers, dual K&N filters with carbon fiber air box, Black aluminum wheels, and bold Yellow and Black presentation, this 2001 Dodge Viper delivers the raw, unmistakable character that helped make the Viper an American performance icon.  The 2001 Dodge Viper is listed by our San Antonio/Austin showroom and can be viewed in greater detail, including 100 plus HD pictures and an HD video, at GatewayClassicCars.com. For more information, email sanantonio@gatewayclassiccars.com or visit us at 679 Holcan Dr, Suite 105, New Braunfels, TX 78130.
